messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from P-322 postmortem (recurring cache eviction pattern). We need remediation owners, short timelines, and specific runbook/playbook edits (triage steps, commands, escalation path). Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/p-322 :link:

kevin: I'll own the config + kv cache tuning. Plan: recreate in staging this week, iterate on max_entries + eviction_policy, run targeted load tests, then a small prod canary. ETA: staging repro by Wed EOD, config PR by Fri.

sara: I'll take runbook + playbook edits. I'll include a 3-step first-responder checklist, exact kubectl commands, and a short rollback entry. Target: PR Thurs morning.

leo: I'll handle monitoring: add two alert severities on cache_eviction_rate. WARN -> slack notify at 2x baseline; SEV -> page SRE + Dedicated lead at 5x baseline. Also add rule: if SEV fires 3 times in 14 days, auto-create follow-up ticket and schedule retro. Will PR alerts by Wed.

oncall-bot: Oncall: SRE = @sara today. Paging policy: 5m ack -> escalate.

kevin: Proposed triage snippet for playbook:

```
# check eviction metric
kubectl exec -it $(kubectl get pods -l app=kv-cache -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- sh -c "curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9090/metrics | grep cache_eviction_rate"

# increase cache entries and change eviction policy
kubectl patch configmap cache-config -p '{"data":{"max_entries":"230000","eviction_policy":"lazy"}}' && kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache
```

sara: Good. I'll add a one-line rollback (apply previous config from git tag) and an explicit escalation ladder: responder -> SRE oncall -> Dedicated lead -> Eng infra at 15m. Also include fallback to `redwood-small` if tail latency > 600ms for >2m.

nina: Agreed owners & timelines:
- kevin: reproduce + config PR (staging Wed EOD; config PR Fri)
- sara: runbook/playbook edits (PR Thurs AM)
- leo: alerts + recurrence rule (PR Wed)

nina: Frank (ops) will run weekly 30m follow-ups until actions closed. Please react with :white_check_mark: to accept. I'll close once PR links and ticket number are posted.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-4807 created for follow-ups (owners: kevin, sara, leo).
